reviews.text: Dr.Lee and Michelle are so great with my anxious Husky. I could not ask for a better Vet.

The vet did not listen to my concerns at all brought my kitten in because she keeps vomiting, he said everything was fine, rushed me out the door. I’ll be taking her to another vet as she has continued to throw up and is now not eating or drinking water. The price is very cheap but I guess it’s true you get what you paid for.
I been coming here over 20 years Love Doctor and all staffs who work there

Always excellent service! Affordable care and clean facility. The staff is always welcoming, compassionate, friendly, and knowledgeable. So glad they are in the neighborhood, but would travel to them if I needed to.
Great doctor and nurse. Affordable prices.

Dr. Lee is a knowledgeable and compassionate vet who took great care of my cat, Melo, for his eye infection. He explained everything clearly and I felt confident in the care Melo received. Highly recommend!

Please don’t bring your pets here 🥺 I Brought my 1 month old kitten in due to her having ringworm ( curable may I add) the vet was super rude and not helpful AT ALL. He almost made me cry when he told me to kill the cat, I had to advocate for the kitten so much for him to actually try and treat her or give me anything for her. Mind you my kitten is about to be 3 months and completely healed no thanks for them. The receptionist lady was super helpful and was trying to help me unlike the vet. I think he should be the receptionist. please go anywhere else and to the vet please do what you love and if being a vet isn’t, please don’t treat animals like they’re disposables. It’s a life. If he was a doctor and a human patient came it and had cancer I feel like he would tell the patient “welp you’re going to die” I’m so serious. Animal life’s are just as important as humans. So to vets please act like a doctor. Thank you. My kitten is Koi hope yall remember
In and out in less than 30 min. Great experience!

I just wanted to take a moment to thank Dr. Lee and Michelle for going above and beyond for us. They were kind enough to fit us in right before closing on a holiday weekend—something we truly appreciated. We called, and they got us in right away.

Their prices are fair, and more importantly, we left with peace of mind, antibiotics, and special food to help our fur baby feel better. Dr. Lee is incredibly kind and knowledgeable—our cat absolutely loved him! It’s been five days since starting the medication, and our cat is doing GREAT!

Thank you so much, Dr. Lee and Michelle! We’re so grateful—and Canelo thanks you too! 🐾
Dr. Lee is the best and understands dogs and their needs. Always recommend everyone here!

Amazing place love the staff . Went there for teeth cleaning for my morkie and they were honest and advised me to wait a bit longer and it wasn’t time . We felt so good there my wife and I we will be coming back and we are making it our regular doctor for our pup.
Such a good place my kitty and my dog are always in good care with them
Staff is very helpful and the doctor is very knowledgeable and has a great report with his animal patients.

My dog wa past away after getting prescription from this doctor. My dog had a light congestion, but this doc gave heavy prescription, which were three medicine for my 7lb baby. I called next day that my baby getting better and I called doctor and asked him to stop medicine. But he pushed to me that kept gave medicine to my baby. That medicine hurted my baby and my baby seriously getting sick by that prescription. This doctor called us suddenly and asked us to go to emergency hospital, and emergency hospital told us that medicine was too strong and hurt kidney. After that my baby passed away within two days. But doctor never called us back for my baby. He asked us to go to emergency hospital and never called back for going situation. How? This doctor is terrible, please don't go this doctor. He does not have any responsible mind for your family.
Dr. Lee and the receptionist were very helpful
Dr. Lee is really great. He knows his stuff and is genuinely concerned about your animal. I know that he works with local rescues which is very important. And his prices are very reasonable.

I just finished our 1 year old Teddy’s consultation with Dr. Lee, and I couldn’t be more impressed. Dr. Lee was incredibly knowledgeable, taking the time to thoroughly assess Teddy’s health and create a tailored regimen to help him thrive. The entire team at the Craigin hospital location was compassionate and welcoming, treating Teddy like a member of their own family. It’s clear that they truly care about the well-being of every animal that walks through their doors.
Easy to make appointments walk-in available better prices than  most other vetanian clinics in Chicago.

This vet is old school, however Dr.Lee is very knowledgeable. And doesn’t take advantage of his patients by charging for necessary labs. I brought my cat when he was having ear issues. The doctor busted out a microscope and diagnosed it …

Don't go here, unprofessional..not very clean/sanitary,the Vet was really old school.
The cost might be extremely inexpensive;but just don't. …
